name: Artificer Core Animations
description: The crafting-bench effects a Process item can choose from. Each entry is an INDEX of CSS that must already exist: an id here means a stylesheet somewhere provides `.artificer-anim-<id>`, reading `--process-level` (0-1) and `--process-color`. Names describe the motion, not the process, so a ferment can pulse and a sieve can shake.

animations.label: None
animations.description: No motion. For processes that should look inert while running.

animations.label: Pulse
animations.description: A slow swell and settle, brightening with intensity. Suits heat, ferment, infusion — anything that builds.

animations.label: Shake
animations.description: A fast rotate and press with a drifting particle field. Suits grind, sift, mill — anything abrasive or agitated.

animations.label: Strike
animations.description: A discrete blow with recovery between, flashing on impact. Suits hammering, chiselling, faceting.

animations.label: Swirl
animations.description: Smooth continuous rotation with a trailing wash. Suits stirring, blending, simmering, tanning.

animations.label: Sweep
animations.description: A stroke passing across the item, which stays still and legible. Suits scribing, drawing, inking, embossing.

animations.label: Shimmer
animations.description: Light drifting over a motionless item. Suits imbuing, attuning, illuminating.

animations.label: Settle
animations.description: Fades toward still, reading as work subsiding rather than continuing. Suits quenching, curing, drying.

animations.label: Ring
animations.description: Expanding rings radiating outward. Suits enchanting, activating, resonating.

animations.label: Blur
animations.description: The item loses definition beneath a colour wash. Suits dissolving, vaporising, transmuting.
